具体词标到物体，动作词标到动作，空间关系用真实对象关系或双幅对比；功能词与抽象词必须有包含该词或明确屈折形式的自然句子和语境，不给虚假的物体框。所有目标词都有独立可查的词条，即使主配文没有包含它。语法词在词句中高亮，不把冠词标成物体。
主配文草案均为原创，不冒充名著或名言。若要求文学配文，先找可核实的原文，提供作者、作品、原文位置、来源URL及使用依据。不得只根据作者去世就断言可商用；单独核查英文原文、所选版本和译文。改写必须标记 adaptation，原创译文标记 original_translation。查不到出处就使用原创句。无需每张都放名言，更不硬凑所有目标词到一条名言里。

image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated ivory and slate clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores with subtle magazine retouch, real hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable, calm blank space near image borders for later annotations. No text, letters, digits, logos, brand names, watermark or UI. Refined homewares shop returns counter. Adult young female customer at left wearing ivory blouse, another adult female shop assistant at right in slate blouse comparing TWO matching white ceramic cups only. LEFT cup new and pristine, complete curved handle, clean glossy surface. RIGHT cup older with one clear chipped rim and broken handle; a separate small handle fragment lies beside it on counter, realistic break not melting. Cups large in clear foreground, hands lightly gesturing behind cups, no fingers inside shards, two faces visible. Original calm exchange interaction, neutral shop shelf background, generous quiet top wall and bottom counter, no printed tags.
